description: List DB server log files of one log type for a Cloud DB for MySQL server instance (use the file names with ncloud_export_mysql_log)

cloudMysqlServerInstanceNo.description: Cloud MySQL server instance number (not the instance number)

logType.description: Log type: BINARY (binlog), ERROR (error log), SLOW (slow query log), GENERAL (general log), AUDIT (audit log)

regionCode.description: Region code (see ncloud_get_regions). Defaults to current region.

name: ncloud_list_mysql_logs
